html:
Warning Letter

Date: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_reported_to_hr, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}

Name: {{ doc.employee_name }}

Designation: {{ doc.designation }}

Emp ID: {{ doc.employee_id }}

Branch: {{ doc.branch_name }}

{% set disciplinary_case = frappe.get_doc("Disciplinary Case", doc.case_id) %}

Region: {{ disciplinary_case.region }}

It has been reported that due care is not being taken by you while discharging your official responsibilities. Allegations of negligence and policy violation are made against you. It has been alleged that you on {{ doc.issue_reported_to_hr}}, have {{ doc.issue_in_details }}.

Please be advised that any negligence in work, behavioral, or policy lapses on the part of any official of the company while discharging the official responsibility or any deviation from the company policies is considered a serious misconduct within the meaning of Human Resource Policies of the company applicable to you.

In your own interest, you are warned to be more careful and vigilant in discharging all your official duties and responsibilities. It is further informed that in case of repeating any such mistakes in future, appropriate disciplinary actions shall be initiated against you by the company.

For Sahayog Multistate Credit Cooperative Society

Authorized Signatory
name: Warning Letter
